While Knox County schools are in session, Route 40, South Knoxville, will be on a long-term detour, for the 2:15 trip, INBOUND ONLY, Monday through Friday.

Inbound from Moody Avenue, continue straight into Sevierville Pike, left on Compton Street, left on Haywood Avenue, left on Cottrell Street, left on Wynn, right on Moody Avenue to the regular route.

description:
Due to construction, Route 32 will be on a long-term detour. 

The outbound routing will be as follows:
From Oakland, left onto Ashland, right onto Andes, right onto MLK, left onto Lakeside, right onto Magnolia, right onto Prosser, right onto Holston/Kirkwood. 

The inbound trip will be as follows: From Kirkwood, left on Magnolia, left on Lakeside, left on Andes, left on Ashland, right on Oakland, to the regular route.
